basic_profile.bio: I'm a 30-something music enthusiast with a penchant for the golden tunes of the 70s. Born and raised in the Midwest, I work as a freelance graphic designer, which gives me the freedom to explore my passion for motorcycles and classic rock. Often found tuning into SiriusXM or exploring scenic bike routes. I'm single and enjoy late-night Reddit browsing, especially on weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in visual arts and a self-taught background in music history, I've always been drawn to the cultural shifts of the 70s. My expertise is a blend of formal education and countless hours spent devouring documentaries and biographies of legendary musicians.
